excluded.usage_idx: post-treatment: AI-tool use during the quarter, after the course; part of how training works, not a background trait
excluded.kudos: post-treatment and a collider: recognition is given partly for completing training and partly for good output, so it is caused by both the action and the outcome
excluded.slot_open: instrument (random seat draw); used only for the complier-effect cross-check, not as a control

hidden_driver_note: Brief says taking the course was voluntary and managers nudged people with a weak previous quarter; that driver (previous-quarter output) is recorded. Personal motivation to take the course is not recorded; the brief does not name it, so it is sized by the sensitivity analysis and checked against the random seat draw.

alternatives.name: Treat AI-tool use as a control
alternatives.why: only right if usage_idx were recorded before the course; the brief says it was after

alternatives.name: Treat recognition points as a control
alternatives.why: only right if kudos were a background trait; the brief says they partly reward training and output

alternatives.name: Ignore last quarter's output
alternatives.why: shows how much the manager nudging of weak performers matters

alternatives.name: Add the seat draw as a control
alternatives.why: if seat availability also tracked something about time zones that affects output

labels.slot_open: Seat open in time zone (random draw)

q_score.meaning: Output score for the previous quarter, same scale as out_m (the before-the-course productivity measure)

slot_open.meaning: 1 if a course seat was open in the employee's time zone at sign-up; seats allocated by random draw (a random nudge to take the course)

flag_t.meaning: 1 = took the AI-tools training course (the action)

usage_idx.meaning: How much the employee used AI tools, from tool logs
usage_idx.recorded: during the quarter, after the course (a consequence of training)

kudos.meaning: Recognition points from peers and managers; partly for good output, partly for completing training
kudos.recorded: end of quarter (after the course and the outcome)

out_m.meaning: Output score this quarter (the productivity measure)
